purpose: Resolve deterministic row mapping and same-width wrong-time selection for word slots that cross an encoder chunk boundary
word_positions: all projected audio rows whose nominal center time is in [word_slot_start_seconds, word_slot_end_seconds); allow the set to span encoder chunks
wrong_time_positions: same number of consecutive projected rows, starting at the first projected row with nominal center at or after word_slot_end_seconds + 0.20 seconds; if not enough rows remain, use the first same-length run ending at or before word_slot_start_seconds - 0.20 seconds; if neither exists, mark wrong-time control ineligible with reason rather than altering selection
wrong_time_intervention: direct donor state swap at these positions; record its norm and do not treat it as norm matched
cached_vs_uncached_prefill_check: capture each chosen decoder layer's post-block state on full prompt with use_cache false and true, compare max and mean absolute differences; retain self-patch outcome as behavioral compatibility check
primary_endpoint_unchanged: complete donor word with normal EOS, exact case-insensitive word match after whitespace trim and removal of at most one final period/exclamation/question mark
secondary_token_rule: tokenize each answer word with its first character uppercased and the remaining characters unchanged, without special tokens; compute first-token donor-minus-recipient logit only if both surfaces are each exactly one token, otherwise record null
interpretation_limit: This addendum handles the Piper chosen-phrasing slot that crosses 2.0 s; it does not change the frozen words, voices, audio bytes, layers, directions, endpoints, or controls.
